statement: No physical Wii Remote speaker acceptance or overrun experiment was run in this source-only session. Decoder readiness after speaker initialization, 8-bit PCM playback acceptance, real ADPCM clock and register-divisor application, volume saturation, actual link pacing, FIFO backpressure, success/error ACK policy for report 0x18, and mute/enable preservation of decoder state remain unknown. Libogc's 6,666,667 ns sender and CWiid's 10,204,081 ns sender differ from each other and cannot establish a hardware timing requirement. Physical investigation should build on audio-wii-speaker-physical-acceptance-unknown, not promote any software emulation or undocumented WiiBrew Speaker section to device proof.

applicability.revision: Original Wii Remote consumer protocol paths; no retail revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: device. No host or hardware execution; speaker source-only consumer analysis; tests and proposed experiments not run. See docs/wii-speaker-consumers.md for pinned locators and bounded inferences.
